scope: One bounded atlas extension, then partial transfer of three existing interpretation claims into rational linear systems.
atlas_rule: Old ordered concept-pair matrices C first, then C*J; merge only identical numeric matrices, retain ALL labelled aliases.
semantic_alias_policy: Emit every alias; no semantic reranking or hidden alias selection.
stop_rule: 64 observations; no seed search, no retries to seek preferred metaphors
reachability_audit: Exact rational boundary partition, outside search and not used for selection

transfer_cases.claim: An unchanged observed picture need not determine the full state.
An intervention can remove one component of a problem while an inaccessible component persists.
The same elements in a different order can produce a different result.

transfer_source: Existing experiment 001 readings, selected before running the expanded atlas; not claimed to have been generated by run 003.
formal_target: Finite-dimensional rational linear maps, observations and controlled transitions
transfer_author: current conversation LLM; explicit modelling choices
